attempts.finding: time.Duration quotient was formatted as a duration string rather than integer milliseconds, causing PostgreSQL set_config to reject statement_timeout before any reservation SQL. Synthetic inventories remained unchanged; no receipts were committed.

limitations: The native run proves only its induced local PostgreSQL histories. No authentication, failover, power loss, backup restore, or remote exactly-once claims.
The bounded network cleanup timeout branch was not induced; it records incomplete cleanup rather than asserting quiescence.
A race-detector pass covers executed schedules only.
